verdict.rationale: INPI Guichet unique is a government web portal for filing company formalities, not an AI agent or assistant host. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is a client-side agent capability, which is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI or agent host features that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
